description: List orders for an event by status or dispute state. Pass page for one page with native pagination; includeTotal defaults to false in page mode.

disputed.description: True selects unresolved disputes; false selects orders without one. Omit for both.

eventId.description: Event ID. Defaults to active event.

includeTotal.description: Ask for the total matching orders. Defaults to false with page.

limit.description: Maximum orders to return, or the page size when all is true.

page.description: Read one page as {items, pagination}. Cannot combine with all.

name: list_orders

items.description: The rows returned by this list operation.

pagination.description: Native page information when a page was requested.

title: List orders
